comment: Single source of truth for the bundled runtime that ships inside bin/.
These executables are NOT committed to git (see .gitignore): tools/fetch-deps.ps1
downloads and verifies them, and the release workflow runs it before packaging.
Run 'pwsh tools/fetch-deps.ps1' to rebuild bin/ locally.
Sizes and sha256 were captured from the upstream release assets on 2026-08-19.

provides.note: Ships the embedded CPython runtime used by bin/pkgs. The packages under pkgs/ contain ABI-specific cp314 .pyd files, so python and pkgs must always be updated together.

excluded.ffmpeg: Deliberately not extracted (~192 MB). Streamlink resolves ffmpeg via shutil.which() i.e. PATH only, and PlayerService._getEnvironmentWithBin puts bin/ on PATH, so the ffmpeg supplied below is what actually gets used. The bundled copy is unreachable dead payload and also exceeds GitHub's 100 MB per-file limit.

provides.note: Supplies BOTH ffmpeg.exe (streamlink muxing, yt-dlp --downloader ffmpeg) and ffprobe.exe (yt-dlp format probing). ffplay.exe is skipped: unused by this app.
Used by yt-dlp for --embed-thumbnail on mp4/m4a. Only exercised when VOD post-processing is enabled.

bundleRequirementsComment: Every path a working install needs, checked by tools/verify-bundle.ps1 against
both the staged directory and the packaged zip before anything is published.
minBytes is a truncation/placeholder floor set to roughly half the real size -
it is not a version assertion. Note streamlink_gui.exe is only ~92 KB because
the Flutter runner is a thin launcher; the Dart code lives in data/app.so.
